applicant.name: Prof. Maria Eder
applicant.organisation: Medical University, department of psychiatry epidemiology

purpose: We map the regional burden of depression in adults to plan community mental-health services.
question: How many adults have a depression diagnosis in each region?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Depression = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with F32.
Report per region: adults with depression.
